reason_for_revision: Development-only analysis exposed a semantic conflation between aggregate execution mode and aggregate expression work. No clean calibration labels were observed.
scientific_question: Can candidate-specific physical work rank legal DuckDB candidates across complete held-out scenario families?

measurement_protocol.machine_state: No concurrent CPU-, memory-, or disk-intensive workload.
measurement_protocol.cache_regime: Warm repeated execution in one DuckDB process and connection.
measurement_protocol.interruption: Use Ctrl+C and resume with --resume latest; incomplete units never enter final artifacts.
measurement_protocol.contamination_rule: Preserve and label a contaminated run; never silently reuse it as clean evidence.

feature_contract_revision.join_build_payload_rate: Fixed to zero because it is exactly collinear in the frozen matrix.
feature_contract_revision.materialization: Write and reread work are represented as one physical round-trip component.
feature_contract_revision.governance: Legality is a hard pre-cost gate; illegal candidates cannot be ranked.
feature_contract_revision.label_boundary: Only label-free work vectors may enter the optimizer.

model_and_validation.model: Nonnegative additive analytic component-cost model with a nonnegative query intercept.
model_and_validation.outer_group: Complete row_count + identifier_width + match_rate family, including every seed and legal candidate.

decision_rule.pass: Freeze the model and support envelope, then design a new real-data month/query-family validation.
decision_rule.fail: Freeze the negative result. Permit at most one bounded diagnosis of missing physical work or non-identifiability; do not tune thresholds or reuse the run as fresh evaluation.
